# Provenance of `examples.json`

`examples.json` is a verbatim copy of aimem's reservation wire v1 example
matrix. It is used only by tests, to keep aicrew's fake reservation service
consistent with the reviewed contract.

- Source repository: <https://github.com/BlackVS/aimem>
- Source path: `docs/fixtures/reservation-v1/examples.json`
- Source commit: `feb36ede466d01df04843240b4b7055dc6f03b59` (aimem PR #117,
  task C4 `01a0d755-5b2e-7000-a232-3422a91a7188`)
- Git blob: `31d9c07bd9a5d41d41ecdbf7eabf1d15a9d4b106` (checked when copied)
- Contract: `docs/DESIGN-AIFORGE-RESERVATION-WIRE.md` at the same commit
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, same licensor as aicrew; aimem's
  `Required Notice:` line is kept in this repository's `LICENSE`.

The file is marked `proposal_only` by its authors: it is a reviewed design,
not a record of a live aimem server. Do not edit it here. A newer version is
copied again, with this note updated.
